mentions.name: IronCalc
mentions.description: IronCalc is a fully open source, light and fast spreadsheet engine designed and built from the ground up. After two years as a side project, it is being developed full time with EU funding (NLnet and Horizon Europe) to become a real product for everyone that can compete with Excel and Google Sheets.
mentions.audience: Everyone / general users; aims to be a real product for everyone to use
mentions.source_excerpt:
Well, I just jumped full time on IronCalc[1] a fully open source, light and fast spreadsheet engine designed and build from the ground up.

I have been working on it as side project for over two years and now, with funding from the EU for the next 2.5 years, I hope I can make of it a real product for everyone to use that can compete with the likes of Excel and Googl;e Sheets.
